item.title: Stop Fighting Slow Zenodo Downloads
item.description:
Today I tried to download a large dataset off Zenodo. The regular download was painfully slow despite a very fast download speed according to [Speedtest] (https://www.speedtest.net). The preview said 38 minutes for 4 GB. At my actual connection speed (937.72 Mbps download, per Speedtest), that same file should take about 34 seconds.

The fix turned out to be a command-line tool called zenodo_get.

How to install

pip install zenodo-get

One gotcha on Windows: after a pip install, the zenodo_get command isn’t always on your PATH. If PowerShell tells you it doesn’t recognize zenodo_get, like it didn’t for me, skip the standalone command and call it as a module instead:
